overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting an anticipated report on a prior AG determination from its meeting notice and by failing to respond to the complaint within fourteen business days.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the Council's meeting notice omitted an anticipated discussion of a prior Attorney General determination against the Council.
allegations.key_passage: The discussion of the determination, therefore, should have been included on the agenda.

allegations.summary: The complainant alleged the Council failed to respond to the open meeting complaint within the fourteen business days required by law.
allegations.key_passage: The Council did not respond until nearly two months had passed, when it was contacted by our office following our receipt of a request for further review of this matter.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Council's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
